title: Evacuation Prep Initiated — Terminal and Ramp Zones

fields.cc: Airport Police Department, Public Information Officer (PIO)
fields.subject: URGENT: Evacuation Protocols Activated for Terminal and Airfield Zones
fields.body:
This memo confirms the activation of full evacuation protocols for Concourse A, Concourse B, and the surrounding airfield ramp zones (Gates A1–A8, B1–B10, and 24), effective immediately.

Based on the received threat (email IR-2026-031, 08:57 AM), and in alignment with TIRP Section 10.2, all personnel are to begin evacuation procedures as per the Bomb Threat Checklist.

Evacuation routes have been posted at all Level 1 and Level 2 exits, and at Gate A1, Gate B3, and Gate 24. Emergency shelters (Shelter A, B, C, D) are open and staffed. ARFF Unit 9 has been placed on standby for medical triage.

All non-essential personnel are to proceed to designated assembly points. Security teams (SEC-PATROL-03, SEC-PATROL-04) are to maintain perimeter control and assist in passenger flow management.

The ACC has been notified. All communications must now route through the EOC emergency VoIP channel (10.66.0.10) until further notice.

This action is taken under Section 4.3 of the AEP, with final authority vested in the Airport Director.

instructorNote: This is a RED HERRING. The threat is cyber, not physical. The 15-minute action is not wrong, but it diverts attention from the digital threat. Watch for teams that accept this as a priority over investigating the scheduled task.
